fidelity: F2a — Heaving-Buoy Linear Hydrodynamic Mass-Spring-Damper ODE
source: Falnes, J. (2002) Ocean Waves and Oscillating Systems, Cambridge UP; Babarit, A. et al. (2012) Renew. Energy 41:44-63; Babarit, A. (2015) Renew. Energy 80:610-628; Pecher & Kofoed (2017) Handbook of Ocean Wave Energy, Springer.

unit.name: Cylindrical Heaving Point Absorber (6 m float, ~10 s natural period)

radius_m.note: Float radius (diameter 6 m, mirrors F1 device)

draft_m.note: Equilibrium submerged draft of cylindrical float

mass_kg.note: Structural + ballast + reaction mass; tuned with added mass so heave T_n ~= 10 s (mirrors F1 device resonance period)

added_mass_kg.note: Heave added mass m_a at the working frequency (Falnes ch.5); combined M=m+m_a sets T_n=2pi sqrt(M/C_hyd)

B_rad_Ns_per_m.note: Radiation (hydrodynamic) damping coefficient at design frequency (Falnes eq. 5.x)

A_wp_m2.note: Water-plane area = pi*r^2 (sets hydrostatic stiffness rho*g*A_wp)

F_exc_coeff_N_per_m.note: Excitation-force coefficient |F_e|/A wave amplitude at design frequency (Falnes Haskind/Froude-Krylov)

B_pto_Ns_per_m.note: PTO (generator) linear damping coefficient; default near optimum |Z_i|

C_pto_N_per_m.note: PTO reactive (spring) stiffness; 0 = pure resistive PTO
